y-m-55-05.s.s1.r.a: x=1, y=1 inogutsa equation yekutanga chete. Funga kana wakaitarisa mu equation yechipiri zvakare.

y-m-55-03.title: Tinofanira kuziva chii nezve a kuti titaure mhinduro?
y-m-55-03.topic: Mhinduro ye linear inequality ine letter mu coefficient
y-m-55-03.goal: Dzidza kuti kana chiratidzo che coefficient a (nekuti iri 0 here) chisingazikanwi, mhinduro ye inequality ax>6 haigoni kunyorwa semhinduro imwe chete, uye utaure ruzivo rwunodiwa nemhinduro munyaya imwe neimwe.
y-m-55-03.material: Taemin akapindura mhinduro ye inequality ax>6 ('a times x is greater than 6') se 'x>6/a.' x ndi real number, uye a ndi real constant, asi kukosha kwe a hakupiwi munyaya (inogona kuva positive, 0, kana negative).
y-m-55-03.thinking.1: Kugadzira iwe pachako muenzaniso unopikisa (a, x)
y-m-55-03.prereq.0: Kuratidza mhinduro ye linear inequality pa number line kana nechiratidzo che inequality (middle school level)
y-m-55-03.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekudzidza kuti kuwedzera kana kuparadzanisa mativi ose maviri ne negative number kunochinja nzira yechiratidzo che inequality
y-m-55-03.s.s1.prompt: Kuti uzive kana mhinduro yaTaemin yakarurama munyaya dzose, chii chekutanga chatinofanira kuziva?
y-m-55-03.s.s1.hint.0: Isa 2 ne −2 se a, uye utsvage zvakananga x mashoma anogutsa ax>6.
y-m-55-03.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kukosha kwe 6/a uye uenzanise kana x dzawakawana dzose dzichigutsa x>6/a.
y-m-55-03.s.s1.o.a: Kana a iri positive, 0, kana negative
y-m-55-03.s.s1.r.a: Uku kufunga kunoda kutarisa chiratidzo che coefficient tisati titaura mhinduro.
y-m-55-03.s.s1.o.b: Kana x yakagadziriswa seinteger kana kuti kwete
y-m-55-03.s.s1.r.b: Rudzi rwe x runochinja chimiro chemhinduro, asi harina hukama hwakawanda nekuti nzira yechiratidzo che inequality yakarurama. Funga kuti chiratidzo chenhamba yaunoparadzanisa nayo chinochinja chii.
y-m-55-03.s.s1.o.c: Kana 6 inoparadzaniswa ne a kana kuti kwete
y-m-55-03.s.s1.r.c: Kuti inoparadzaniswa zvakanaka here hakuna basa pakati pe real numbers. Cherekedza kuti divisor nderudzi rupi rwenhamba.
y-m-55-03.s.s1.o.d: Kana x iri hombe kana diki kupfuura 0
y-m-55-03.s.s1.r.d: Kuziva chiratidzo che x kunogona kudzikisa mhinduro, asi kuti expression yaTaemin yakarurama here kunoenderana ne a.
y-m-55-03.s.s1.explain: Kana ukaparadzanisa mativi ose maviri e ax>6 ne a, nzira yechiratidzo che inequality inosiyana kana a iri positive uye kana iri negative, uye kana a=0 haugoni kuparadzanisa. Saka chiratidzo che a (nekuti iri 0 here) chinodiwa.
y-m-55-03.s.s2.prompt: Isa mapeya 2 (a, x), ane makosha e a akasiyana, anogutsa ax>6 asi asina kusanganisirwa mumhinduro yaTaemin x>6/a. (Tora a seyakakosha isiri 0.)
y-m-55-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza a imwe positive neimwe negative, uye utsvage zvakananga x yakadai kuti ax>6.
y-m-55-03.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga 6/a kuti uenzanise kana x yawakawana ichigutsa x>6/a, uye utarise kuti a ipi iri padivi risingagutsi.
y-m-55-03.s.s2.fail.c1: ax haina kukura kupfuura 6. Tarisazve product ye a ne x.
y-m-55-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Haina kusanganisirwa mumhinduro yaTaemin x>6/a. Mhinduro yaTaemin yakashata.
y-m-55-03.s.s2.fail.c2: (a, x) iyi inosanganisirwawo mumhinduro yaTaemin x>6/a. Haiiti muenzaniso unopikisa. Edza kuchinja chiratidzo che a.
y-m-55-03.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana a=−2, x=−4, saka ax=8>6, asi 6/a=−3 uye x=−4 yakaderera kupfuura −3. Ndiko kuti, mhinduro yaTaemin x>6/a haina kururama kana a iri negative.
y-m-55-03.s.s3.prompt: Rongedza kuna Taemin kuti mhinduro inosiyana sei zvichienderana nekukosha kwe a. Fungawo uye unyore nyaya a=0.
y-m-55-03.s.s3.hint.0: Kana a iri positive, tarisa nenhamba kana x inoita kuti ax>6 iri hombe kana diki kupfuura 6/a.
y-m-55-03.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora kuti unowana expression ipi kana waisa a=0 zvakananga mu ax>6.
y-m-55-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakabata nyaya dzose nhatu, a positive, negative, ne 0 here?
y-m-55-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakaisa kukosha kumwe kwe a mumhinduro yawakanyora uye wakatarisa kuti ax>6 inoshanda here?
y-m-55-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakasiyanisa chirevo 'hatigoni kuchinyora semhinduro imwe chete nekuti hapana ruzivo' nechirevo 'tinogona kuchinyora kana tikaparadzanisa kuita nyaya' here?
y-m-55-03.s.s3.model.0: Kana a iri positive, x>6/a; kana a iri negative, kuparadzanisa mativi ose maviri ne a negative kunodzosera chiratidzo che inequality, saka x<6/a. Kana a=0, inova 0>6, saka hapana mhinduro.
y-m-55-03.s.s3.model.1: Kana a>0, x>6/a; kana a<0, x<6/a; kana a=0, hapana x inogutsa ax>6, saka hapana mhinduro.

y-m-55-02.title: Kudzora midzi ye x²+kx+4=0 na k
y-m-55-02.topic: Huwandu nezviratidzo zvemidzi chaiyo yechirevo che quadratic
y-m-55-02.goal: Tarisa, nokugadzira mienzaniso, kuti kuchirevo che quadratic chine vara k huwandu nezviratidzo zvemidzi chaiyo zvinochinja nokukosha kwa k, uye utsanangure nenhamba kuti sei k iri pamusoro isingashande.
y-m-55-02.material: k inhamba yakagadzikana chaiyo, uye mhinduro dzechirevo x²+kx+4=0 (x sikweya pamwe k nguva x pamwe 4 yakaenzana 0) dzinofungwa pakati penhamba chaiyo chete. Kana ukachinja k, huwandu nezviratidzo zvemhinduro chaiyo zvinochinja.
y-m-55-02.thinking.1: Kugadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei inosangana namamiriro (midzi chaiyo miviri yakasiyana iri pamusoro)
y-m-55-02.thinking.2: Kutsanangura nemienzaniso yenhamba kuti sei mamiriro anodikanwa
y-m-55-02.prereq.0: Chirevo chemidzi (mhinduro) yechirevo che quadratic nokuziva kuparadzira zvirevo zvechimiro x²+px+q (nhanho yechikoro chepakati)
y-m-55-02.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza k dzose umo chirevo ichi chine mhinduro chaiyo imwe chete.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga nekukosha kushoma se k = 0, 2, isa kukosha kushoma pa x uye utarise kana x²+kx+4 ingava 0.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti kukosha kudiki zvikuru kwechirevo kunofanira kuva chii kuti girafu ingobata aksi ye x, uye unyorezve x²+kx+4 muchimiro (x+k/2)² + (…) uye uratidze kukosha uku nomuna k.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.a: Mu x²+4=0, x² yaifanira kuva negative, saka hapana mhinduro chaiyo zvachose. Tarisazve kuti mhinduro imwe inoonekwa riini.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.b: Iyi ipfungwa inoedza kunyorazve chirevo muchimiro chesikweya yakakwana.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.c: Se x²+2x+4 = (x+1)²+3, inogara iri pamusoro, saka hapana mhinduro. Mhinduro haioneki nokuti k isiri 0.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.d: Iyi ipfungwa yakatarisa k ine chiratidzo chakapesana nenzira imwe chete.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.r.e: Zviri nyore kufunga kuti k ikakura, mhinduro dzakawanda. x²+8x+4=0 ine mhinduro chaiyo mbiri dzakasiyana.
y-m-55-02.s.s1.explain: Kana k=4, saka x²+4x+4 = (x+2)², uye kana k=−4, saka x²−4x+4 = (x−2)², saka pane mhinduro imwe (mhinduro yakapetwa). Kuna k=0 ne k=2 hapana mhinduro, uye kuna k=8 pane mhinduro mbiri dzakasiyana.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.prompt: Isa nhamba dzizere 3 dzakasiyana k umo x²+kx+4=0 ine mhinduro chaiyo mbiri dzakasiyana dziri pamusoro.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzirisa k imwe, gadzirisa x²+kx+4=0 zvakananga, uye utarise kana mhinduro mbiri dzakasiyana dzichibuda.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kana wawana mhinduro, tarisa zviratidzo kuti dzose dziri pamusoro here, uye kana kwete, chinja chiratidzo che k uye uyedze zvakare.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita k ive nhamba yakazara.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Hadzisi mhinduro chaiyo mbiri dzakasiyana. Hapana mhinduro kana mhinduro imwe. Tarisazve padhuze nokukosha kwomuganho.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Mhinduro dzose mbiri hadzisi pamusoro. Tarisa zviratidzo zvemhinduro zvakananga.
y-m-55-02.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, kana k=−5, saka x²−5x+4 = (x−1)(x−4), saka mhinduro ndi 1 ne 4. Kuna k=−4 pane mhinduro imwe (2), uye kuna k=5 mhinduro ndi −1 ne −4, dzose dziri negative. Kuti uzadzise chiratidzo nehuwandu zvose, k inofanira kuva shoma pa −4.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.prompt: Sei mhinduro dzose mbiri dzisingagoni kuva pamusoro kuna k iri pamusoro se k = 5? Tsanangura uchishandisa nhamba.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.hint.0: Gadzirisa x²+5x+4=0 zvakananga ne k=5 uye unyore zviratidzo zvemhinduro mbiri.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kuti chiratidzo che term imwe neimwe ye x²+5x+4 chinova chii kana ukaisa nhamba positive chete se x.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mhinduro chaidzo dzakaverengwa mumuenzaniso wenhamba wandakapa here?
y-m-55-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakati 'nei zvakadaro nguva dzose kana k iri positive' sechikonzero here kwete nemuenzaniso mumwe chete?
y-m-55-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ndakafunga here kuti chii chinoitika pamakosha emuganhu senge k=4 ne k=−4?
y-m-55-02.s.s3.model.0: Kana k=5, saka x²+5x+4 = (x+1)(x+4)=0, saka mhinduro ndi −1 ne −4, dzose negative. Kuti mhinduro dzive positive, k inofanira kuva negative.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.model.1: Kana x iri positive, x², 5x, ne4 zvose ndezve positive, saka sum yazvo haigoni kuva 0. Saka kana k iri positive, hapana mhinduro ye positive.
y-m-55-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro inotsanangura nezviratidzo pasina kutsvaga mhinduro zvakananga inoshandawo.

y-m-55-01.title: Kutarisa kana kukosha kwawawana kuri mhinduro chaizvo
y-m-55-01.topic: Kutarisa mhinduro dzechirevo chine chisingazivikanwi mumuparadzanisi
y-m-55-01.goal: Kuchirevo chine chisingazivikanwi mumuparadzanisi, tsvaga mamiriro api anobvumira shanduko mukugadzirisa, tarisa nokuisa kukosha kwawawana muchirevo chekutanga kana ichi mhinduro, uye ugadzirise nhevedzano yemhinduro.
y-m-55-01.material: Hyunwoo akagadzirisa chirevo x/(x−2) = 2/(x−2). (Nzira yokuverenga: "x pamusoro pe (x bvisa 2) yakaenzana 2 pamusoro pe (x bvisa 2)." x inhamba chaiyo.) Hyunwoo akati, "x=2 ndiyo mhinduro. Handifungi kuti ndinoda kuitarisa."
y-m-55-01.thinking.0: Kutsvaga kana mutsetse wega wega wemhinduro une mamiriro akavanzika
y-m-55-01.thinking.1: Kutarisa zvakasiyana kana kukosha kwawawana ndiko musarudzwa chete kana mhinduro chaiyo
y-m-55-01.thinking.2: Kutaura mhedziso ('hapana mhinduro') pamwe chete nehumbowo hwayo
y-m-55-01.prereq.0: Kuti muchirevo chechikamu kukosha hakutsanangurwi kana muparadzanisi uri 0 (nhanho yechikoro chepakati)
y-m-55-01.prereq.2: Nyaya yebasa: 'H3' inongova chiratidzo chenhanho yokuoma nokutsigira yeboka rebasa iri uye haisarudzi kuti rinodzidzwa kugiredhi rei rechikoro chepamusoro. y-m-55-01.s.s1.prompt: Chii chinoitika kana ukaisa mhinduro yaHyeonu x=2 zvakananga panzvimbo ye x muchirevo chekutanga x/(x−2) = 2/(x−2)?
y-m-55-01.s.s1.hint.0: Isa 2 panzvimbo ye x uye utanga waverenga kuti muparadzanisi x−2 unova chii.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga kana chikamu chine zvarinoreva kana muparadzanisi wacho uri kukosha uku.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.o.a: Mativi ose mbiri anova nokukosha kumwe chete, saka chirevo chinoshanda
y-m-55-01.s.s1.r.a: Wakatora kuti mativi ose mbiri ane chimiro chakafanana sokuti ane kukosha. Tanga wakatarisa kukosha kwomuparadzanisi.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.o.b: Muparadzanisi x−2 unova 0, saka kukosha kwemativi ose mbiri hakutsanangurwi
y-m-55-01.s.s1.r.b: Iyi ipfungwa inotanga yakatarisa kana kukosha kwechirevo kuripo.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.o.c: Mativi ose mbiri anova 0, saka 0=0 inoshanda
y-m-55-01.s.s1.r.c: Unogona kunge wakavhiringidza x apo nhamba iri pamusoro iri 0 ne x apo muparadzanisi uri 0. Kana x=2, nhamba iri pamusoro ndi 2.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.o.d: Divi rokuruboshwe rinova 0 uye divi rokurudyi rinova 1, saka dzakasiyana
y-m-55-01.s.s1.r.d: Wakaedza kutora chikamu chine 0 mumuparadzanisi sokunge inhamba. Kukosha kwakaparadzanwa ne 0 hakutsanangurwi.
y-m-55-01.s.s1.explain: Kana ukaisa x=2, muparadzanisi x−2 unova 0, saka divi rokuruboshwe kana rokurudyi hazvina kukosha kwakatsanangurwa. Saka haugoni kuti 'mativi ose mbiri akaenzana,' uye 2 haigamuchirwi semhinduro.
y-m-55-01.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe wakanganisa mumhinduro yaHyeonu.
y-m-55-01.s.s2.hint.0: Padivi pomutsetse wega wega, nyora kana paine 'mamiriro umo unogona kuita izvi.'
y-m-55-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti x dzipi dzinoita kuti chirevo x−2 chakashandiswa mumutsetse 1 chive 0.
y-m-55-01.s.s2.line.0: Wanza mativi ose mbiri e x/(x−2) = 2/(x−2) na (x−2).
y-m-55-01.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 1 wakaita shanduko inogona kuitwa chete kana x−2 isiri 0, asi yakaitwa pasina mamiriro. y-m-55-09.title: Tinogona kunyora (a+b)² sa a²+b² riini?
y-m-55-09.topic: Maformula ekuwanza nekuwedzera mitaurire ine tsamba
y-m-55-09.goal: Ongorora kukanganisa kwekutenda kuti mutaurire wakaongororwa nekukosha kumwe kana kuviri unogara uchishanda, uye ugadzire mienzaniso yekuongorora kuti musiyano pakati pe (a+b)² ne a²+b² unotaurwa sei uye kuti unova 0 riini.
y-m-55-09.material: Daeun anofunga (a+b)² = a²+b². (Maitiro ekuverenga: 'square ya a pamwe b yakaenzana ne a squared pamwe b squared.')
